# case: health-dmarc-inherited-sp
## problems
warn fix.p.dmarc-no-rua {}
## notes
fix.n.dmarc-sp {"from":"none","to":"quarantine"}
fix.n.report-ttl {"ttl":3600}
## check
z=example.com&r=is+_dmarc+TXT+%22v=DMARC1;+p=reject;+sp=quarantine;+pct=50%22%5E%22v=DMARC1;+p=reject;+sp=none;+pct=50%22
## bind
; DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
; The records below are what the changed sets hold afterwards;
; every other record of the zone stays as it is.
$ORIGIN example.com.

; _dmarc.example.com TXT (DMARC); the other TXT records of _dmarc stay
_dmarc 3600 IN TXT "v=DMARC1; p=reject; sp=quarantine; pct=50"
; delete: _dmarc 3600 IN TXT "v=DMARC1; p=reject; sp=none; pct=50"
## route53
{
  "Comment": "DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)",
  "Changes": [
    {
      "Action": "UPSERT",
      "ResourceRecordSet": {
        "Name": "_dmarc.example.com.",
        "Type": "TXT",
        "TTL": 3600,
        "ResourceRecords": [
          {
            "Value": "\"v=DMARC1; p=reject; sp=quarantine; pct=50\""
          }
        ]
      }
    }
  ]
}
## cloudflare
#!/bin/sh
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# Needs an API token that may edit this zone's DNS records (Zone > DNS > Edit) and the zone ID
# (the zone's Overview page). Neither is written here: set both in your shell first.
: "${CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN:?set CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN to your API token}"
: "${CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID:?set CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID to the zone ID of example.com}"
API="https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/zones/$CLOUDFLARE_ZONE_ID/dns_records"

# 1. Change _dmarc.example.com TXT (DMARC): "v=DMARC1; p=reject; sp=none; pct=50" -> "v=DMARC1; p=reject; sp=quarantine; pct=50"
#    Find the record's id, then:
curl -sS "$API?type=TXT&name=_dmarc.example.com" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN"
curl -sS -X PATCH "$API/RECORD_ID" -H "Authorization: Bearer $CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  --data '{"type":"TXT","name":"_dmarc.example.com","content":"\"v=DMARC1; p=reject; sp=quarantine; pct=50\"","ttl":3600}'
## cloudflare notes
fix.fn.cloudflare-ids {}
## octodns
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# In the zone's YAML (example.com.yaml): set these entries; the other names stay as they are.
---
_dmarc:
  - ttl: 3600
    type: TXT
    values:
      - 'v=DMARC1\; p=reject\; sp=quarantine\; pct=50'
## terraform-cloudflare
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# terraform-provider-cloudflare v4 (cloudflare_record; v5 names it cloudflare_dns_record).
variable "cloudflare_zone_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "The zone ID of example.com"
}

# change: the resource that holds _dmarc.example.com TXT "v=DMARC1; p=reject; sp=none; pct=50" gets the value below

resource "cloudflare_record" "txt_dmarc" {
  zone_id  = var.cloudflare_zone_id
  name     = "_dmarc.example.com"
  type     = "TXT"
  content  = "v=DMARC1; p=reject; sp=quarantine; pct=50"
  ttl      = 3600
}
## terraform-route53
# DNS change request for example.com (DomainScope)
# aws_route53_record manages a whole record set: every value of the name and type is listed.
variable "route53_zone_id" {
  type        = string
  description = "The hosted zone ID of example.com"
}

resource "aws_route53_record" "txt_dmarc" {
  zone_id = var.route53_zone_id
  name    = "_dmarc.example.com"
  type    = "TXT"
  ttl     = 3600
  records = ["v=DMARC1; p=reject; sp=quarantine; pct=50"]
}
## en
DNS change request: example.com

Please make the following changes in the DNS zone example.com. Records not listed here stay as they are.

1. Replace: DMARC record (TXT)
   Name: _dmarc.example.com
   Value:
     "v=DMARC1; p=reject; sp=quarantine; pct=50"
   TTL: 3600
   This removes:
     "v=DMARC1; p=reject; sp=none; pct=50"
   The other TXT records of the name stay as they are.

Notes:
- Names under the domain without a DMARC record of their own go from sp=none to sp=quarantine: watch the reports of mail sent as them for a week or two.
- The TTL 3600 is a default: a public resolver does not tell a zone’s own TTL. A record that is only changed can keep the TTL it has.

Once the change is made, this link shows whether public DNS resolvers see it:
https://example.github.io/domainscope/#/change/check?z=example.com&r=is+_dmarc+TXT+%22v=DMARC1;+p=reject;+sp=quarantine;+pct=50%22%5E%22v=DMARC1;+p=reject;+sp=none;+pct=50%22
## tr
DNS değişiklik talebi: example.com

Lütfen example.com DNS zone’unda aşağıdaki değişiklikleri yapın. Burada yer almayan kayıtlar olduğu gibi kalır.

1. Değiştir: DMARC kaydı (TXT)
   Ad: _dmarc.example.com
   Değer:
     "v=DMARC1; p=reject; sp=quarantine; pct=50"
   TTL: 3600
   Bu değişiklikle kaldırılanlar:
     "v=DMARC1; p=reject; sp=none; pct=50"
   Adın diğer TXT kayıtları olduğu gibi kalır.

Notlar:
- Alan adının altında kendi DMARC kaydı olmayan adlar sp=none politikasından sp=quarantine politikasına geçer: onların adına gönderilen e-postaların raporlarını bir iki hafta izleyin.
- 3600 TTL değeri varsayılandır: genel bir çözümleyici zone’daki asıl TTL’i bildirmez. Yalnızca değiştirilen bir kayıt mevcut TTL’ini koruyabilir.

Değişiklik yapıldıktan sonra genel DNS çözümleyicilerinin onu görüp görmediğini bu bağlantı gösterir:
https://example.github.io/domainscope/#/change/check?z=example.com&r=is+_dmarc+TXT+%22v=DMARC1;+p=reject;+sp=quarantine;+pct=50%22%5E%22v=DMARC1;+p=reject;+sp=none;+pct=50%22
